# MoveEntity <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Blitz3D](Blitz3D) · [Entities](Blitz3D-Entities)

</div>


```blitzbasic
MoveEntity:Void entity:Int32, x:Float32, y:Float32, z:Float32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `entity` | In | Int32 | required | Entity handle. |
| `x` | In | Float32 | required | Distance to the right. |
| `y` | In | Float32 | required | Distance upwards. |
| `z` | In | Float32 | required | Distance forward. |

## Description

Moves an entity in the direction it faces. The offset is in the entity's own space: +Z is forward, +X is right and +Y is up, wherever the entity looks. That makes it the right command for cars, bullets and cameras that fly where they point. To move along the world axes use [TranslateEntity](TranslateEntity).
